0022600140.text: The New Orleans Pelicans, now 0-3 and on a three-game losing streak, host the Denver Nuggets (1-2, currently on a one-game skid) in the fourth game of the Pelicans' season. New Orleans sits 14th in the West and fifth in the Southwest, 3.5 games back, and Yves Missi is out with a knee bruise, while Denver, 10th in the West and fourth in the Northwest, 2.5 games back, is without Alpha Diallo (personal), Julian Strawther (knee sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring), with Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) listed as day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Pelicans trail 0-1 in the 2026-27 season series after losing 141-135 in Denver on October 24, and they were swept 0-3 by the Nuggets in the 2025-26 season.
